hits.snippet: **York Space Systems**, a U\.S\.-based defense and commercial aerospace prime contractor, has agreed to acquire **Solestial**\. The transaction is designed to secure a critical space solar capability within York’s \(NYSE: YSS\) supply chain through U\.S\.-based manufacturing, reducing dependence on Chinese-controlled materials and production\. Upon closing, Solestial will operate as a wholly owned subsidiary of York while continuing to serve commercial, civil and national security customers\. Founded in Tempe, Ariz\., Solestial develops ultrathin, radiation-hardened silicon solar cells and modules engineered for the space environment\. The company says it is the only provider offering self-healing silicon technology proven on orbit, positioning it as an alternative to legacy III-V solar technologies that face high costs and long lead times\. Solestial has built a predominantly domestic supply chain, with approximately 95 percent of suppliers based in the U\.S\., and recently expanded its manufacturing capabilities through the acquisition of high-volume solar production equipment to support wafer-to-module manufacturing in the U\.S\.
